layout_fit.reason: Four pinned direct final-spec dumps prove 77x47 natural fit, no clipping or graph occlusion, and zero bridges. The category also requires complete source coverage across views, which fails for qualifiers and comparison.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Within views groups have appropriate distinct hue families and no group outlines. The named wifi group changes from magenta (206,115,206) to orange (206,161,115); name-stable group hue required by round contract. This is a group-family instability, not a demand for exact per-node color persistence.

border_integrity.reason: Normal ANSI and select-all ANSI show intact continuous colored borders for all 17 node occurrences; select-all is simultaneous, not individually selected captures.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen hashes verified; 17 command records preserve output and preserved drafts match logged digests; four validators report 33/33 and capture artifact hashes verified. One abandoned-shape digest is mistyped in attempts.json but the preserved draft matches its command record. The shell-wrapped probe frame record has null binary_path and binary_sha256, so the binary actually executed for that probe lacks a contemporaneous hash binding; the command names the frozen path, whose current hash is verified but cannot prove historical bytes.

findings.description: Address belongs to e5 but begins at col 46, closer to e6 col 44 than e5 col 42. Both source stems remain traceable, but label ownership fails the explicit equal-or-nearer rule; no impossible-placement evidence.

Router identity is a historical claim, but v4 asserts Fios rtr with no claim/historical marker. In v3 (hist.) is attached after WNC and may qualify only that interpretation rather than the Fios identity. Split labels expose an unqualified claim in the egress view.

No global v6 is stated, but ULA-only prefixes are absent; the source explains that distinction. The 4-ISP/2-MMR contrast is also omitted, not equivalent to just 1 ISP/1 path and MMR analog. Bench answers NAT, no committed rate, and no global v6 remain extractable across v4/v2/v1.
The same declared wifi group changes hue family from magenta RGB 206,115,206 to orange RGB 206,161,115 across v2/v3, violating name-stable group-family requirement; no group boundary is drawn.
Identity-probe-map is the right family and secondary fan/chain recipes are visible, but its all-qualifier/identifier coverage demand is not met (F1–F3), with no recorded yield.

attempts.json abandoned v1-a1 spec digest has a transcription error; actual preserved spec matches attempts-log.jsonl. A shell-wrapped probe frame record has null binary_sha256; its command names the frozen binary, whose current bytes match metadata. This does not erase the other recorded bindings, but the missing contemporaneous binding limits that one probe.
